t: This is Dump Trump, a 16-foot-high statue of Donald Trump sitting on a golden toilet. It was installed temporarily in Trafalgar Square ahead of his 2019 visit to the United Kingdom. It was also displayed in Washington, D.C., during the Salute to America on 4 July 2019. It depicts the American politician, media personality and businessman who served as the 45th president of the United States and is now the 47th.
